v1.1.6 Update
- Map Surround pages now retain their frame settings, layout variants, and theme information when duplicated, imported from page JSON, or saved as recovery copies.
- Copies use independent Map Surround Sets. Use Add a Map in the copy's map management window to attach maps.
- Single-layout recovery copies keep the draft's layout when another GM has changed the saved frame.
Pages that have already lost their Map Surround settings are not restored automatically.

announcement.title: 🎨 Landing Page Maker v1.1.6
announcement.content:
Landing Page Maker v1.1.6

  • Map Surround pages now retain their frame settings, layout variants, and theme information when duplicated, imported from page JSON, or saved as recovery copies.
  • Copies use independent Map Surround Sets. Use Add a Map in the copy's map management window to attach maps.
  • Single-layout recovery copies keep the draft's layout when another GM has changed the saved frame.

Pages that have already lost their Map Surround settings are not restored automatically.
